historical_commentary.text: This note documents a native-OS-API plug-in (QuickTime on Mac, GDI+ on Windows) that gave 4D 2004 an enhanced picture display area supporting zoom, scroll bars, and drag-and-drop between pictures, fields, and list boxes, distributed with full C source code. QuickTime has been discontinued by Apple for years and GDI+ is a legacy Windows API, so this plug-in's specific native dependencies are obsolete, though the general idea of a rich picture-display container control with zoom/scroll/drag-drop remains conceptually similar to picture-handling controls in modern 4D.
related_updates: Apple discontinued QuickTime years ago, and GDI+ is a legacy Windows graphics API superseded by newer Windows imaging frameworks
4D has since expanded its native picture object/commands, reducing the need for OS-native plug-ins like this one for enhanced picture display
